title: Hunter Biden’s Legal Problems Keep Getting Worse

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson, and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·朗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档关于设计之爱及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth
sentences.zh: 即使是在黑胶唱片时代的夜店当DJ，你每晚也要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去工作，然后你把DJ台

sentences.en: into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 变成了一个活生生的、充满50年历史精美文物的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, a plea deal struck between the Department of Justice and Hunter Biden was supposed to bring his years-long legal problems to an end.
sentences.zh: 今天，司法部与亨特·拜登达成的认罪协议本应结束他多年来的法律困境。

sentences.en: Instead, that deal has unraveled, and a special counsel has been named to take over the case.
sentences.zh: 然而，该协议已经破裂，司法部已任命一名特别检察官接手此案。

sentences.en: My colleague, Mike Schmidt, explains why that turn of events is increasingly pitting the interests of Hunter Biden against those of President Biden.
sentences.zh: 我的同事迈克·施密特将解释为什么这一事态发展正日益使亨特·拜登的利益与拜登总统的利益发生冲突。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, August 17th.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月17日，星期四。

sentences.en: Hi, Mike.
sentences.zh: 你好，迈克。

sentences.en: What's going on?
sentences.zh: 最近怎么样？

sentences.en: We're going to do this again.
sentences.zh: 我们又要重来一次了。

sentences.en: This is the song that never ends.
sentences.zh: 这真是没完没了的歌。

sentences.en: Oh, this is the song.
sentences.zh: 哦，这就是那首歌。

sentences.en: It goes on and on again.
sentences.zh: 它又在循环播放了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Some quality stuff right there.
sentences.zh: 真是高质量的内容。

sentences.en: Are you ready?
sentences.zh: 准备好了吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 准备好了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Mike.
sentences.zh: 迈克。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 在。

sentences.en: Welcome back.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回来。

sentences.en: Good to be here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴来到这里。

sentences.en: To get to this point where we are right now, In the Hunter Biden saga, where he now faces a full-blown special counsel investigation.
sentences.zh: 要谈到亨特·拜登事件目前的进展，即他现在面临全面的特别检察官调查，

sentences.en: I think you and I have to go back to the last time you were on the show to a plea deal that we thought was a done deal between Hunter Biden and the Department of Justice.
sentences.zh: 我想你我得回到你上次上节目的时候，当时我们以为亨特·拜登和司法部之间的认罪协议已经板上钉钉了。

sentences.en: And that plea deal looked like it was going to forever end this years-long sprawling investigation into Hunter Biden's conduct over the past few years.
sentences.zh: 那份认罪协议看起来似乎能永远结束这场针对亨特·拜登过去几年行为的、旷日持久的调查。

sentences.en: And in the episode where you and I talked about that deal, which ran on July 26th, that morning the plea deal was going to be signed and it was all going to be over.
sentences.zh: 在你我讨论那份协议的节目中——也就是7月26日播出的那一期——那天早上，认罪协议本应签署，一切本应结束。

sentences.en: That didn't happen.
sentences.zh: 但那并没有发生。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So when Hunter Biden's heading into court that morning, we think this is going to be a very perfunctory day.
sentences.zh: 所以当亨特·拜登那天早上前往法院时，我们以为这只是走个过场。

sentences.en: This is a hearing that is essentially glorified paperwork.
sentences.zh: 这本来是一场本质上只是美化过的文书工作的听证会。

sentences.en: He's going to go before a judge.
sentences.zh: 他要出庭面对法官。

sentences.en: The judge is going to ask him some questions to make sure he knows what he's doing.
sentences.zh: 法官会问他一些问题，以确保他清楚自己在做什么。

sentences.en: Some documents are going to be signed.
sentences.zh: 一些文件会被签署。

sentences.en: And we're going to have this plea deal that brings to an end this wide-ranging investigation that had looked at all this different stuff in his life.
sentences.zh: 然后我们就会达成这份认罪协议，结束这场审视他生活中各种琐事的广泛调查。

sentences.en: Right, and just remind us what is in the plea deal before we get to how it goes off the rails.
sentences.zh: 没错，在我们谈论它如何脱轨之前，先提醒一下认罪协议里到底有什么。

sentences.en: So over the past five years or so, the United States attorney in Delaware, who was appointed by Donald Trump and actually kept on by the Biden administration
sentences.zh: 过去五年左右的时间里，特拉华州的联邦检察官——他是由唐纳德·特朗普任命的，实际上被拜登政府留任

sentences.en: to lead this investigation.
sentences.zh: 来领导这项调查。

sentences.en: Guy named David Weiss.
sentences.zh: 一个叫大卫·韦斯的人。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: He had looked at a broad array of Hunter Biden's conduct from his foreign business dealings with companies like Burisma, which I'm sure people have heard of
sentences.zh: 他审视了亨特·拜登广泛的行为，从他与布里斯马（Burisma）等公司的外国商业往来——我相信人们都听说过，

sentences.en: but are not totally sure what it is.
sentences.zh: 但并不完全确定那是什么。

sentences.en: Energy company in Ukraine?
sentences.zh: 乌克兰的一家能源公司？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And his use of drugs, his purchase of a weapon, his finances, his taxes.
sentences.zh: 还有他吸毒、购买武器、财务状况以及税务问题。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Donald Trump and Republicans claimed that this investigation was going to end the five decades of the Biden family in American politics.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普和共和党人声称，这项调查将终结拜登家族在美国政坛五十年的统治。

sentences.en: It was going to expose criminality that had been committed by Hunter Biden and his father.
sentences.zh: 它将揭露亨特·拜登和他父亲所犯下的罪行。

sentences.en: But instead, we were left with two misdemeanor tax charges and a diversion agreement on the purchase of a gun in which Hunter Biden had lied to the federal government
sentences.zh: 但结果我们只看到了两项轻罪税务指控，以及一份关于非法购枪的延期起诉协议，因为亨特·拜登在购枪时对联邦政府撒了谎，

sentences.en: about whether he was using drugs at the time that he tried to make the purchase.
sentences.zh: 隐瞒了他在购枪时是否正在吸毒的事实。

sentences.en: and no jail time.
sentences.zh: 而且没有监禁。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And as we talked about with you in this last episode, this was an outcome.
sentences.zh: 正如我们在上一期节目中与你讨论的那样，这是一个结果。

sentences.en: This was a plea deal from that big, vast landscape down to these two and a half or so charges that really infuriated Republicans who felt it was a scandalously sweetheart deal
sentences.zh: 这份从大规模调查缩减到这两项半指控的认罪协议，确实激怒了共和党人，他们认为这对总统的儿子来说是一份丑闻般的优待协议，

sentences.en: for the president's son and a huge relief for Democrats who'd always felt this investigation was bigger than it needed to be and that Hunter Biden had never committed any crime,
sentences.zh: 而对于一直认为这项调查没必要搞这么大、且亨特·拜登从未犯罪的民主党人来说，这是一种巨大的解脱，

sentences.en: so this just made sense.
sentences.zh: 所以这在他们看来合情合理。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Okay, so what happened exactly to this plea bargain deal that you just described?
sentences.zh: 好的，那么你刚才描述的这份认罪协议到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: So Hunter Biden went into court for what we thought was going to be this straightforward, perfunctory hearing,
sentences.zh: 亨特·拜登走进法庭，参加我们认为是一场直截了当、走过场的听证会，

sentences.en: and it quickly went off the rails.
sentences.zh: 结果很快就脱轨了。

sentences.en: How so?
sentences.zh: 怎么说？

sentences.en: At the heart of this deal, one of the main reasons why Hunter Biden came to the table was his understanding that he was going to get immunity
sentences.zh: 这份协议的核心，也是亨特·拜登愿意坐到谈判桌前的主要原因之一，是他认为自己将获得豁免权，

sentences.en: essentially insulation from prosecution from the Justice Department for all of this conduct.
sentences.zh: 本质上是免受司法部对他所有这些行为的起诉。

sentences.en: His foreign business dealings, his work for Burisma, his work with Chinese business officials.
sentences.zh: 他的外国商业往来、为布里斯马公司的工作、与中国商业官员的合作。

sentences.en: The whole scope of this Department of Justice Investigation, his understanding was that once he pleaded guilty to a tax charge and a gun charge,
sentences.zh: 整个司法部调查的范围，他的理解是，一旦他承认一项税务指控和一项枪支指控，

sentences.en: that he would never be charged with anything else related to the original investigation.
sentences.zh: 他就永远不会再因与最初调查相关的任何其他事情而被起诉。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Hunter Biden says, I'm coming to the table.
sentences.zh: 亨特·拜登说，我愿意配合。

sentences.en: I'll plead to these tax charges, but we got to give me an ending to this investigation that has hung over me and my family for so many years.
sentences.zh: 我会承认这些税务指控，但你们必须给我一个终结，结束这场多年来一直笼罩着我和我家人的调查。

sentences.en: And I mean, maybe this is an obvious question, but why exactly is that so important to him?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这可能是一个显而易见的问题，但为什么这对他就那么重要？

sentences.en: Well, I think that if you're under investigation, it's important to know that it's over and you can truly take a deep breath.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为如果你正在接受调查，知道它已经结束并能真正松一口气是很重要的。

sentences.en: But there was something else, something bigger that was hanging over this, and that was Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 但还有别的东西，更重要的东西笼罩着这一切，那就是唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: So at the heart of this deal is immunity, immunity that Hunter Biden wanted.
sentences.zh: 所以这份协议的核心是豁免权，亨特·拜登想要的豁免权。

sentences.en: Why did he really want immunity?
sentences.zh: 他为什么那么想要豁免权？

sentences.en: because if his father loses re-election and Donald Trump becomes president,
sentences.zh: 因为如果他父亲竞选连任失败，唐纳德·特朗普当选总统，

sentences.en: Donald Trump has essentially said he will use the Justice Department to prosecute his political enemies.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普基本上已经说过，他会利用司法部来起诉他的政治敌人。

sentences.en: Right, and Hunter Biden's certainly...
sentences.zh: 没错，而亨特·拜登当然……

sentences.en: Number one, number two, number three, wherever you want to put him in, you know.
sentences.zh: 第一、第二、第三，无论你想把他排在第几位，你知道的。

sentences.en: He might be number one, number two, and number three.
sentences.zh: 他可能是第一、第二和第三号目标。

sentences.en: In other words, Hunter Biden worries that Donald Trump could be re-elected and turn his Department of Justice into kind of a one-man wrecking ball aimed at Hunter Biden.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，亨特·拜登担心唐纳德·特朗普如果再次当选，会将司法部变成一个专门针对他的“拆迁大锤”。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: One of the most important things that I think gets lost in the shuffle of Trump is his desires to use the powers of the federal government proactively against those he doesn't like.
sentences.zh: 我认为在特朗普的混乱中被忽略的最重要的事情之一，是他想要主动利用联邦政府的权力去对付那些他不喜欢的人。

sentences.en: And he has said this openly.
sentences.zh: 他公开说过这一点。

sentences.en: He has said, this is what I'm going to do.
sentences.zh: 他说过，这就是我要做的。

sentences.en: So if you're Hunter Biden, you know that you've been a target of Donald Trump, and there's a chance your father could lose re-election, you want that protection.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你是亨特·拜登，你知道自己一直是唐纳德·特朗普的目标，而且你父亲有竞选连任失败的风险，你就会想要那种保护。

sentences.en: And Hunter Biden's understanding as he prepares to sign this document in a perfunctory manner, get this deal over with,
sentences.zh: 而亨特·拜登在准备以走过场的方式签署这份文件、结束这笔交易时，他的理解是，

sentences.en: is that he has baked into this deal exactly that level of broad immunity you just described.
sentences.zh: 他已经在这份协议中植入了你刚才描述的那种广泛的豁免权。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But in the courtroom, the judge, looking at this deal,
sentences.zh: 但在法庭上，法官看着这份协议，

sentences.en: focuses in on the paragraph on immunity and starts questioning the prosecutors about what appears to be a pretty broad level of immunity.
sentences.zh: 聚焦于关于豁免权的段落，并开始质问检察官关于看起来相当广泛的豁免权范围的问题。

sentences.en: And in response to the judge's questions, the prosecutors give a far more narrow definition of what they think the immunity applies to.
sentences.zh: 作为对法官提问的回应，检察官对他们认为豁免权适用的范围给出了一个狭窄得多的定义。

sentences.en: How narrow?
sentences.zh: 有多窄？

sentences.en: Narrow to Hunter Biden's taxes and his purchase of the gun, but not all of his foreign business dealings over the past decade.
sentences.zh: 仅限于亨特·拜登的税务和购枪问题，而不包括他过去十年所有的外国商业往来。

sentences.en: So not this protective shield of a very broad kind that Hunter Biden wanted and understood this plea deal to give him that would potentially protect him against a future Donald Trump Department of Justice investigation instead of criminal charges.
sentences.zh: 所以，这并不是亨特·拜登想要并理解的那种能保护他免受未来唐纳德·特朗普司法部调查及刑事指控的广泛保护盾。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it was outrageous because this was one of the most high profile investigations the Justice Department had undertaken in the past few years.
sentences.zh: 这简直令人愤慨，因为这是司法部过去几年进行的最受瞩目的调查之一。

sentences.en: Both sides had finally come to a deal and they walked into a courtroom in front of a judge where they knew the deal would be closely looked at and picked over.
sentences.zh: 双方终于达成了一项协议，他们走进法庭，面对一位他们知道会仔细审视并挑剔这份协议的法官。

sentences.en: And they had completely different understandings of the most central part of the whole agreement.
sentences.zh: 而他们对整个协议中最核心部分的理解竟然完全不同。

sentences.en: So what's outrageous, because I just want to be really clear,
sentences.zh: 那么，什么令人愤慨呢？因为我想弄清楚一点，

sentences.en: is the fact that professional lawyers on a case this important somehow had been so derelict that they didn't fundamentally understand the deal that they were a party to.
sentences.zh: 事实是，在如此重要的案件中，专业的律师竟然如此失职，以至于他们根本没有搞清楚自己所参与的协议内容。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: How did that happen?
sentences.zh: 这是怎么发生的？

sentences.en: Hunter Biden's defense lawyer is a guy named Chris Clark, who's a former federal prosecutor and is considered to know what he's doing.
sentences.zh: 亨特·拜登的辩护律师是一个叫克里斯·克拉克的人，他曾是联邦检察官，被认为很专业。

sentences.en: So it's hard to think, like, I don't think that Chris Clark walks in the courtroom thinking, oh,
sentences.zh: 所以很难想象，我不认为克里斯·克拉克走进法庭时会想，哦，

sentences.en: we're going to pull a fast one here and get broad immunity that the government wasn't going to give us.
sentences.zh: 我们要在这里耍个花招，获得政府本不打算给我们的广泛豁免权。

sentences.en: What about the Justice Department lawyers?
sentences.zh: 那司法部的律师呢？

sentences.en: How do you explain them not necessarily knowing just how broad this immunity was?
sentences.zh: 你怎么解释他们不一定知道这份豁免权到底有多广泛？

sentences.en: It doesn't make any sense.
sentences.zh: 这根本说不通。

sentences.en: One of the biggest questions we still have is that how do you have such a high-profile matter that you know is going into court and there be diametrically different views on the most important part of it?
sentences.zh: 我们仍然面临的最大问题之一是，你怎么能让这样一个备受瞩目的案件在进入法庭时，对其中最重要的部分却有截然不同的看法？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So we don't know why these experienced, prestigious lawyers on both sides are confused, but they are confused.
sentences.zh: 所以我们不知道为什么双方这些经验丰富、声名显赫的律师会感到困惑，但他们确实困惑了。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the judge goes on to highlight other issues she has with this deal.
sentences.zh: 法官继续强调了她对这份协议的其他疑虑。

sentences.en: And this thing, which we thought was a layup and essentially signing of paperwork, gets put on hold.
sentences.zh: 而这件我们以为是板上钉钉、只需走个过场签署文件的事情，被搁置了。

sentences.en: She says, Justice Department, Hunter Biden's lawyers, go back and try and figure this out.
sentences.zh: 她说，司法部，亨特·拜登的律师们，回去把这个问题搞清楚。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Get on the same page.
sentences.zh: 达成共识。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Which is a logical thing for both sides to do.
sentences.zh: 这对双方来说都是合乎逻辑的做法。

sentences.en: Leave the courtroom, maybe with their tails between their legs, because this is all pretty embarrassing, and try to renegotiate this plea deal so that everyone is on the same page.
sentences.zh: 离开法庭，也许会感到灰头土脸，因为这一切都很尴尬，然后尝试重新谈判这份认罪协议，让每个人都达成共识。

sentences.en: Is that what happens?
sentences.zh: 后来发生了什么？

sentences.en: In the days that follow, there's a back and forth between Hunter Biden's lawyers and the prosecutors in Delaware on trying to reach a deal.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几天里，亨特·拜登的律师和特拉华州的检察官之间就达成协议进行了反复沟通。

sentences.en: And those negotiations are not going well.
sentences.zh: 但那些谈判进展并不顺利。

sentences.en: And it appears like that deal or whatever deal anyone thought they had is unreachable.
sentences.zh: 看起来那份协议，或者任何人以为他们达成的任何协议，都无法实现。

sentences.en: And if the deal is unreachable, then there's only sort of one conclusion or two conclusions about where this is headed.
sentences.zh: 如果协议无法达成，那么对于这件事的走向，只有一两个结论。

sentences.en: Either the government is going to walk away from it, they're going to walk away from a case of the president's son, or they're going to have to go to trial.
sentences.zh: 要么政府放弃，他们放弃起诉总统的儿子，要么他们必须进行审判。

sentences.en: But Mike, wouldn't a trial be very bad for Hunter Biden?
sentences.zh: 但是迈克，审判对亨特·拜登来说不是非常糟糕吗？

sentences.en: Because unlike a plea deal, it would be public, it would probably be long, and it might mean jail time, which was never part of this plea deal.
sentences.zh: 因为与认罪协议不同，审判是公开的，可能会持续很长时间，而且可能意味着监禁，而这在认罪协议中从未涉及。

sentences.en: And a trial, correct me if I'm wrong, it doesn't get Hunter Biden any immunity from future criminal charges, right?

sentences.zh: 韦斯先生的任命向美国人民重申了司法部在处理特别敏感事项时，对独立性和问责制的承诺。

sentences.en: I am confident that Mr. Weiss will carry out his responsibility in an even-handed and urgent manner and in accordance with the highest traditions of this department.

sentences.en: So, Mike, what's our understanding of why David Weiss, this U.S.

sentences.en: So up until this point, Garland and the Justice Department have been saying, Weiss has all the independence that he needs.

sentences.en: attorney.

sentences.en: But what a special counsel appointment does is it really solidifies that.

sentences.en: How so?

sentences.en: Because it comes with added provisions that give that prosecutor more independence, or at least the perception of it.
sentences.zh: 因为它附带了额外的条款，赋予了检察官更多的独立性，或者至少是这种观感。

sentences.en: There are three major things that do that.
sentences.zh: 有三件主要的事情起到了这个作用。

sentences.en: The first is that prosecutor still reports to the attorney general, but is not managed on a day-to-day basis.
sentences.zh: 首先，检察官仍然向司法部长汇报，但不会受到日常管理。

sentences.en: Remember, this is an investigation in which the president's son is under investigation by his Justice Department that is run by his political appointees.
sentences.zh: 记住，这是一项由总统的政治任命人员领导的司法部，对总统儿子进行调查的案件。

sentences.en: Right, so this is a classic case where a special counsel seems merited because you want that prosecutor to feel independent since the investigation is kind of looking inward
sentences.zh: 没错，这是一个典型的需要特别检察官的案例，因为你希望检察官感到独立，毕竟调查在某种程度上是在审视内部，

sentences.en: at the president and the president's family.
sentences.zh: 即总统和总统的家人。

sentences.en: Kind of reminds me of Trump and special counsel Robert Mueller, who was looking at Trump's relationship to Russia.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起了特朗普和特别检察官罗伯特·穆勒（Robert Mueller），后者当时正在调查特朗普与俄罗斯的关系。

sentences.en: You want an independent prosecutor if that prosecutor's looking at the president.
sentences.zh: 如果检察官在调查总统，你确实需要一位独立的检察官。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The second thing is that if that prosecutor wants to take a major investigative move and is overruled by their higher-ups, the attorney general has to report that to Congress.
sentences.zh: 第二点是，如果检察官想要采取重大的调查行动却被上级否决，司法部长必须向国会报告。

sentences.en: As an added layer of accountability.
sentences.zh: 作为增加的一层问责机制。

sentences.en: Extra sunshine into how the investigation is being run.
sentences.zh: 让调查的运作过程更加透明。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the third thing is that that prosecutor, when they are done with their investigation, can write a report, a potentially damning report,
sentences.zh: 第三点是，检察官在完成调查后，可以写一份报告，一份可能具有破坏性的报告，

sentences.en: to the attorney general about what they found.
sentences.zh: 提交给司法部长，说明他们的发现。

sentences.en: And that report can become public, similar to what we saw at the end of Robert Mueller's investigation into Trump's ties to Russia.
sentences.zh: 这份报告可以公开，类似于我们在罗伯特·穆勒对特朗普与俄罗斯关系的调查结束时所看到的那样。

sentences.en: Okay, why do we think Weiss, if he was, as we have reported in the Times, at the end of a years-long investigation, suddenly wants all these layers of independence
sentences.zh: 好的，为什么我们认为韦斯在经过多年调查后（正如我们在《时报》所报道的那样），会突然想要所有这些来自司法部的独立性保障？

sentences.en: from the Justice Department?

sentences.en: And that has left us trying to figure out what was behind that requeSt. Why did he think he needed that?
sentences.zh: 这让我们不得不去探究那个请求背后的原因。他为什么觉得有必要这样做？

sentences.en: And what's a logical explanation?

sentences.en: Well, one is, is that if he's going to go to trial,
sentences.zh: 嗯，其中一个原因是，如果他要进入审判阶段，

sentences.en: having that extra layer of insulation and perception would be a great thing for a prosecutor to have if they're walking into court and trying to make a case.
sentences.zh: 对于检察官来说，在走进法庭试图立案时，拥有那层额外的保护和观感将是一件极好的事情。

sentences.en: Against the president's son.

sentences.en: Correct.

sentences.zh: 好的，鉴于目前为止发生的一切，迈克，我想谈谈我们预计韦斯将如何利用他作为特别检察官的新身份。

sentences.zh: 我之所以这样问，是因为我们知道，

sentences.en: And if you look at the history of these types of prosecutors who've been appointed in the post-Nixon era, they often start on something and end up on a completely different place
sentences.zh: 如果你看看后尼克松时代任命的这类检察官的历史，他们往往从某件事开始，最终却在完全不同的地方结束，
